//                         contracts, expand control, footer, note dots
//    _related             related-projects mosaic + border-sheen keyframes
//    _carousel-overrides  internals items inside a .carousel track
//    _legal               legal-page container (zero-padding %MAXAREA)
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@import '../../base/variables';
@import '../../base/mixins';
@import '../../base/fonts';
@import '../../base/placeholders';
@import '../../base/structure';

@import 'internals/internal';
@import 'internals/related';
@import 'internals/carousel-overrides';
